source.title: Pause nonterminal C2 Master Goal after each deterministic watchdog wake
source.objective: Native C2 Master Goal auto-continuation bypasses deterministic watchdog suppression: c2-master-goal-start sets thread/goal status active before waiting for its turn, but does not pause the Goal after a non-terminal turn finishes. Evidence after deterministic watchdog deployment: watchdog state remained waiting_external with should_wake_goal=false and unchanged last_wake_at, c2-master-goal.service was inactive, yet new Master Goal assistant turns continued to appear. Impact: repeated model-driven polling/token burn persists even though the watcher no longer wakes the Goal. Fix the controller so each deterministic wake yields one bounded turn and leaves a still-active/nonterminal Goal paused until the control-plane fingerprint changes.
